primary_population: Fresh conversations under the frozen stimuli and requested model/effort settings
primary_observation: impact == 1 AND counterfactual == no, with both fields valid
primary_prediction: First joint report at round t, after that round's two choices and feedback and before that round's rating, conditional on no prior joint report
profile_unit: model by reasoning effort; 24 requested profiles remain distinguishable

core_split.object_stratification: 15 conversations per target in each split

control_use: Prespecified descriptive and condition contrasts; not predictive model selection
R_A_use: Round-10 between-conversation comparison with en_schema, standardized equally over the four obj targets; no round-1-to-9 onset inference
input_restrictions: Only information visible through the current round may enter a prediction
No future K/D path, future report, hidden target schedule or terminal response
Initial K/D prior is symmetric for Bayesian consistency candidates
Stage-1 changes across rounds and stage-2 changes across rounds are separate from interleaved K/D changes

selection.primary_score: conversation-summed first-event log loss, mean within each core cell then equal-weight mean across cells within each profile
selection.heldout_evaluation: Once after the development-only specification and fitted models are versioned; any subsequent revision is exploratory
selection.insufficient_information: Report uncertainty or abstain where events or covariate support are insufficient; do not claim zero risk from zero observed events

missingness: Do not encode invalid reports as zero. A gap before an observed joint report prevents an exact onset claim; report interval-censored or unknown onset and prespecified complete-prefix sensitivity analyses.
terminal_policy: All terminal questions occur after round-10 rating. Explanation versus neutral is preassigned; subsequent predictions and reratings are separate from spontaneous first-ten-round endpoints.
uncertainty_unit: Conversation, with condition and execution-batch sensitivity; repeated rounds and prediction components are not independent conversations
prohibited_interpretations: K/D association as randomized causal effect
joint report as direct private mechanism knowledge or human subjective SoA
predictive success as identification of a unique internal LLM algorithm
review_scope: Automated invariants and independent AI semantic/code review; no completed independent human semantic review is claimed
